verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Raise disputes API for filing disputes on behalf of cardholders and offers a Dispute webhook type, which covers programmatic filing and status notifications. Evidence submission is described only as a zip upload through the Customer Area, a pilot feature, so it is not clearly programmatic. Network reason codes and provisional credit handling are not evidenced. Missing for 10: documented network reason code support, API-based evidence submission (only a pilot Customer Area upload is shown), provisional credit handling, detail on dispute status lifecycle through resolution, independent corroboration.
